minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, October 18, 2023
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order
  at 10:00 AM on Wednesday, October 18, 2023.

  Members present: Terry Kistler, George Borst, Bette Donovan, Rafaela Giles and
  Scott Snider.

  Members Absent: Jenny Jolly and Edward Padgett.

  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Community Services Director, Armando
  Cisneros, Community Services Specialist, Robyn Olsen, Community Services
  Specialist.

  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, September
  20, 2023 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: Lonnie Shipman, Community Risk Reduction Specialist, La Verne
  Fire Department. This is a new position for the Fire Department to specialize in fire
  prevention. He reports to the Fire Marshall. He explained the importance of
  preparing for emergencies and going out into the community to explain how to
  prepare for emergency situations. He speaks at mobile home communities and
  explains the importance of fire alarms and to make sure you have the proper
  number of alarms in your homes to ensure that gas leaks are detected. Also
  explained the importance of carbon monoxide alarms.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: Meals were served to an average of 29 participants per week
  in September.

  Meals on Wheels: 640 meals served to 45 La Verne recipients in September.

4. Bingo Report: The total balance in the account for the month of September
  was $151.25. The average attendance for September was 49 players per
  week.

5. Account Balance: $5,504.87
 6. Senior Program Fees: All programs are paid for September. The senior program fee
  will be raised to $1.00 after the first of the year.

7. MT. SAC Classes: Fall session for Mt. SAC has begun.

8. Aging Next: September total number of La Verne residents served was 7. (via
  Joslyn Center and Aging Next office).

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: Aquatic Center, bid approved. La Verne won the contest for
  Perk your Park and will receive $75,000.

10. Upcoming Events:

  - Tuesday, October 24 – Senior Seminar: Brain Health and Aging present by YWCA and
  Independence at Home, 9:30AM
  - Wednesday, October 24 – Senior Seminar: Medicare, Why the Myth’s about
  Reverse Mortgages are not accurate, Presented by Longbridge Financial, 9:30AM
  - Thursday, November 2– Excursion, Valley View Casino, 8:30 AM-6:30PM
  - Friday, November 3 – Senior Seminar: Stop Falling! Home and Safety and
  Preventing Falls and Injuries, Presented by Independence at Home, 9:30AM
  - Sunday, November 5 – Country Western Senior Dinner Dance, 4:00PM-
  7:00PM.
  - Tuesday, November 8– Senior Seminar: Medicare, Presented by TMB Insurance,
  9:30AM
  - Friday, November 14 – Excursion: California Science Center, 8:30AM-3:00PM
  - Friday, November 17 – Beating the Holiday Blues, Presented by Independence at
  Home, 9:30AM

11. Public Comments: Scott informed us about the new Art Exhibit at Hillcrest. Also,
  they are starting to book holiday events. Taste of La Verne is tonight, October 18.
  Yvonne gave us information about starting a Bunco group. We cannot have money
  involved but prizes are ok. Bette will investigate how other centers are getting
  prizes. Hopefully we will have better information by January. George gave an
  update on Senior Golf league. Seems some people have now been keeping track of
  their correct scores. Will be taking a closer look at that. Will be having their winter
  cup event in November. Lorraine thanked everyone for the surprise retirement
  recognition and gifts.

12. Adjourn: It was moved and seconded to adjourn the meeting at 11:00AM.
  Motion carried. The next meeting will be on Wednesday, November 15, 2023 at
  10:00AM.
